notes_for_editor: Two listings only. The tnlandforms list gives coordinates; the Forest Lookouts index gives the county and agency heading with no date, height or design. Two searches and the cached pages found nothing on build date, staffing, fires or status. The record's agency is null and is filled here from the index heading. A 1928 tower on the Misc. Notes page is near Windsor in Bertie County, not Chowan, so it is not used. The story is well under the 120-word guide because the evidence is thin. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the cited tnlandforms.us page does not name Tom Dunigan, so that name was removed from the story and this record; restore it only from a source that names him.
